powers.name: Sharpened Steel
powers.desc: Your army gains 10% attack damage.

powers.name: Reserve Guard
powers.desc: Your army gains 45 health for every champion waiting on your bench.

powers.name: The Empty Throne
powers.desc: If you leave at least one board slot empty, your army deals 25% more damage and gains 250 health.

powers.name: Battle Hymn
powers.desc: Your army gains 15% attack speed.

powers.name: Frontline Doctrine
powers.desc: Champions in your front two rows gain 300 health.

powers.name: Backline Doctrine
powers.desc: Champions in your back two rows deal 18% more damage.

powers.name: Executioner's Oath
powers.desc: Your army executes enemies below 10% health.

powers.name: Opening Salvo
powers.desc: Your army starts combat with 30 extra energy.

powers.name: Crown of the Fallen
powers.desc: Your army deals 1% more damage for every 3 health your Sovereign is missing.

powers.name: Wildkin Pact
powers.desc: Your army counts one extra Wildkin, and Wildkin turn feral below 70% health instead of 50%.

powers.name: Royal Treasury
powers.desc: Interest is paid for every 8 Crowns you hold instead of every 10 (still at most +5).

powers.name: Forge Master's Favor
powers.desc: Gain a random component now. Every Boss encounter gives you one extra component.

powers.name: Overflowing Bench
powers.desc: Your bench holds 2 more champions. Gain 3 Crowns.

powers.name: Crown's Favor
powers.desc: Gain a Crown Shard now, and every Boss encounter gives you another.

powers.name: Last Stand
powers.desc: Whenever an ally dies, your surviving army gains 8% attack speed (stacking).

powers.name: Crown of War
powers.desc: Your army gains 20% attack damage, 20 ability power and 15% attack speed.

powers.name: Golden Parting
powers.desc: Gain 5 Crowns now. Selling a ★★ champion gives 3 extra Crowns; a ★★★ gives 10 extra.

powers.name: Steady Coffers
powers.desc: Gain 1 extra Crown every round.

powers.name: Crown Bond
powers.desc: Invest up to 20 of your Crowns now. After 5 more rounds, the bond pays out 2.5× what you invested. Buying XP costs 3 Crowns.

powers.name: Deep Vault
powers.desc: While you hold 50 or more Crowns at the start of a round, gain 2 bonus Crowns.

powers.name: Free Rolls
powers.desc: Gain 1 free reroll every round.

powers.name: Victor's Spoils
powers.desc: Gain 2 Crowns after every combat you win.

powers.name: Windfall
powers.desc: Gain 18 Crowns.

powers.name: Merchant Prince
powers.desc: Rerolls cost 1 Crown.

powers.name: Consolation Prize
powers.desc: After each loss, gain 3 Crowns and 2 XP.

powers.name: Golden Crown
powers.desc: Gain 2 extra Crowns every round, and 3 more while you hold 50 or more.

powers.name: Tempered by Victory
powers.desc: Gain 4 XP. After every 2 PvP victories, a component held by one of your fielded champions evolves into a completed item.

powers.name: Lucky Draw
powers.desc: Gain a random Tier III champion.

powers.name: Mirror Shard
powers.desc: Gain a copy of the champion you own the most copies of (a random Tier I champion if you own none).

powers.name: Studious
powers.desc: Gain 2 extra XP every round.

powers.name: Twin Blessing
powers.desc: Gain 2 copies of a random Tier II champion you own (or any Tier II if you own none).

powers.name: Higher Calling
powers.desc: Gain 10 XP.

powers.name: Oath of the Fourth Crown
powers.desc: Swear to the Tier II champion you own the most copies of. Gain 2 copies of it now and 1 more every round for the rest of the match, beyond ★★★: three ★★★ ascend to ★★★★.

powers.name: Ascension Rite
powers.desc: A random ★ champion on your board ascends to ★★.

powers.name: Star-Touched
powers.desc: Your ★★ and ★★★ champions gain 15% health and deal 15% more damage.

powers.name: Prodigy's Path
powers.desc: You can field 1 more champion.

powers.name: Apex Ascension
powers.desc: You can field 1 more champion. Gain 10 XP.

powers.name: Pandora's Satchel
powers.desc: Gain 2 random item components.

powers.name: Wild Gift
powers.desc: Gain a random champion of Tier I to IV.

powers.name: Coin Flip
powers.desc: Heads: gain 12 Crowns. Tails: gain 4 Crowns and a component.

powers.name: Roll of Fate
powers.desc: Every round, gain 0 to 4 Crowns at random.

powers.name: Chaotic Surge
powers.desc: At combat start, a random ally gains 60% attack damage, 60 ability power and 60% attack speed.

powers.name: Grand Convergence
powers.desc: Every trait you have at least one champion in counts one extra champion. Gain 3 free rerolls.

powers.name: Mystery Box
powers.desc: Gain a random completed item.

powers.name: Dice of the Crownfall
powers.desc: At combat start, each ally gains one random buff: +20% attack speed, +25 ability power, +20% attack damage, +200 health or +25 armour and resistance.

powers.name: Wildfire
powers.desc: At combat start, 3 random enemy champions burn for true damage equal to 20% of their max health over 5s.

powers.name: Crown of Chaos
powers.desc: Gain 2 random completed items and a random Tier IV champion.

powers.name: Crown Dummy
powers.desc: At combat start, summon a Crown Dummy with 700 health in your front line.

powers.name: Crest of the Kingdom
powers.desc: Your army counts as having 1 extra Kingdom champion.

powers.name: Crest of Gears
powers.desc: Your army counts as having 1 extra Gearbound champion.

powers.name: Crest of the Stars
powers.desc: Your army counts as having 1 extra Astral champion.

powers.name: Crest of the Grove
powers.desc: Your army counts as having 1 extra Verdant champion.

powers.name: Crest of the Rift
powers.desc: Your army counts as having 1 extra Riftborn champion.

powers.name: Crest of Blades
powers.desc: Your army counts as having 1 extra Duelist champion.

powers.name: Rebirth Rite
powers.desc: The first of your champions to fall each combat returns 2s later at full health, dealing 50% more damage.

powers.name: Summoner's Pact
powers.desc: Your summons gain 40% health and attack damage.

powers.name: Living Arena
powers.desc: At combat start, summon 2 Treants with 800 health. Your army gains 200 health.

powers.name: Blood Price
powers.desc: Lose 8 health. Gain 12 Crowns.

powers.name: Crimson Augury
powers.desc: Your shop rolls as if you were one level higher, but every paid reroll costs 2 health.

powers.name: Dark Bargain
powers.desc: Lose 12 health. Gain a random Tier IV champion and 6 XP.

powers.name: Soul Tax
powers.desc: Every round, lose 1 health and gain 3 Crowns.

powers.name: Sacrificial Rite
powers.desc: Lose 10 health. A random ★ champion on your board ascends to ★★.

powers.name: Void Pact
powers.desc: Your army deals 25% more damage, but you take 3 extra damage when you lose.

powers.name: Glass Crown
powers.desc: Your army gains 30% attack damage and 30 ability power but has 20% less health.

powers.name: Abyssal Hunger
powers.desc: Your army heals for 20% of all damage dealt.

powers.name: Crown of Nothing
powers.desc: Lose 20 health. Your army deals 40% more damage.

powers.name: Unmaking Pact
powers.desc: Lose 15 health. You can field 2 more champions.

items.name: The Fallen King's Blade
items.effect: Every takedown grants the holder 15% attack damage and 15% attack speed for the rest of combat.

items.name: Crown of the First Realm
items.effect: Each of the holder's origins counts one extra champion for your traits.

items.name: Hourglass of Ash
items.effect: Once per combat, when the holder would drop below 25% health, time rewinds: it becomes untargetable for 1.5s and heals to 60% health.

items.name: Titan's Last Heart
items.effect: When the holder falls, every ally gains a shield equal to 25% of the holder's max health for 4s.

items.name: The Starless Tome
items.effect: Every second ability the holder casts is echoed 0.6s later at full power.

items.name: Colossus Edge
items.effect: Attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 3% of the target's maximum health.

items.name: Crownreaper
items.effect: Each attack grants 5% attack speed, stacking up to 10 times. Takedowns refresh the stacks to maximum. A second Crownreaper doubles it.

items.name: Spellforged Saber
items.effect: Abilities can critically strike.

items.name: Crownsworn Blade
items.effect: Deal 12% more damage. Gain 15 energy on takedown.

items.name: Kingsblood Edge
items.effect: The first time the holder drops below 40% health, gain a shield equal to 30% of max health for 5s.

items.name: Veilpiercer
items.effect: Attacks reduce the target's resistance by 35% for 4s.

items.name: Bloodoath Blade
items.effect: Heal for 22% of all damage dealt.

items.name: Deadeye Edge
items.effect: Critical strikes deal much more damage.

items.name: Tempest Engine
items.effect: Gains 4% attack speed every second of combat (up to 60%). Every 5th attack strikes twice.

items.name: Storm Engine
items.effect: Every third attack releases chain lightning dealing 70 magic damage to up to 3 enemies.

items.name: Chrono Band
items.effect: After casting, gain 40% attack speed for 3s.

items.name: Resolute Buckler
items.effect: When hit, gain 2 armour and 2% attack speed, stacking up to 15 times.

items.name: Phase Mantle
items.effect: 25% chance to dodge attacks.

items.name: Quickened Heart
items.effect: Attacks heal the holder for 2% of max health.

items.name: Falconeye Bow
items.effect: Attacks also strike a second nearby enemy for 50% damage.

items.name: Astral Diadem
items.effect: A large amount of ability power.

items.name: Starfire Codex
items.effect: Attacks restore 5 extra energy. Each cast grants 10 ability power for the rest of combat.

items.name: Aegis Codex
items.effect: Combat start: the holder and adjacent allies gain 25 armour and resistance.

items.name: Hexflame Orb
items.effect: Ability damage burns for 20% of the damage over 3s and reduces the target's healing by 40% for 3s.

items.name: Verdant Chalice
items.effect: Every 3s, heal the lowest-health ally for 70 (+ability power).

items.name: Seer's Prism
items.effect: After casting, the next 3 attacks deal 45 bonus magic damage.

items.name: Wellspring Circlet
items.effect: After casting, restore 20 energy.

items.name: Rallying Standard
items.effect: Combat start: allies in the holder's row gain a 200 shield for 6s.

items.name: Spell Shroud
items.effect: Blocks the first 3 instances of ability damage.

items.name: Phoenix Plume
items.effect: The first time the holder dies, it revives after 2s with 40% health.

items.name: Fatebinder
items.effect: After casting, the holder's next 2 attacks are guaranteed critical strikes.

items.name: Thornward Mail
items.effect: When attacked, deal 35 magic damage back to the attacker.

items.name: Twin Aegis
items.effect: Immune to stun, root and hex.

items.name: Bastion of the Deep
items.effect: Combat start: gain a shield equal to 30% of max health for 8s.

items.name: Watchward Visor
items.effect: The holder and adjacent allies cannot be critically struck.

items.name: Starveil Cloak
items.effect: Take 30% less magic damage.

items.name: Sanctified Mantle
items.effect: Every 4s, cleanse crowd control and heal 5% max health.

items.name: Nullifier Grip
items.effect: Attacks drain 10 energy from the target.

items.name: Mountainheart
items.effect: +25% maximum health. Regenerate 1% max health per second.

items.name: Reaper's Grasp
items.effect: Attacks and abilities execute enemies below 12% health.

items.name: Fate's Edge
items.effect: Critical strikes ignore 50% of armour.

items.name: Unbinding Charm
items.effect: Use on a champion to return all of its items to your item bench.

items.name: Kingdom Emblem
items.effect: The holder gains the Kingdom trait and counts toward it.

items.name: Wildkin Emblem
items.effect: The holder gains the Wildkin trait and counts toward it.

items.name: Astral Emblem
items.effect: The holder gains the Astral trait and counts toward it.

items.name: Hollow Emblem
items.effect: The holder gains the Hollow trait and counts toward it.

items.name: Gearbound Emblem
items.effect: The holder gains the Gearbound trait and counts toward it.

items.name: Umbral Emblem
items.effect: The holder gains the Umbral trait and counts toward it.

items.name: Verdant Emblem
items.effect: The holder gains the Verdant trait and counts toward it.

items.name: Riftborn Emblem
items.effect: The holder gains the Riftborn trait and counts toward it.

items.name: Crown Shard
items.effect: A fragment of the Crown. Combine with a component to forge an Emblem, or with another Crown Shard to forge the Sovereign Crown.

items.name: Sovereign Crown
items.effect: While the holder is on your board, you can field one more champion.

edicts.name: Crown's Bounty
edicts.proclamation: The Crown pays its soldiers before the first battle.
edicts.description: Every contender begins the match with 4 Crowns.

edicts.name: The Open Market
edicts.proclamation: Every bargain is open today. Look again — and again.
edicts.description: Shop rerolls cost 1 Crown instead of 2 for the whole match.

edicts.name: Scholar's Ascent
edicts.proclamation: Climb, and the Firmament will lift you higher.
edicts.description: Buying XP grants 2 extra XP (6 XP for the usual price).

edicts.name: Relic Tide
edicts.proclamation: The forgotten kings have left their treasures unguarded.
edicts.description: Bosses are twice as likely to drop a Crown Artifact.

edicts.name: Shard Season
edicts.proclamation: The Lattice is breaking. Catch the pieces.
edicts.description: From Stage 2, every Crown Draft offers one Crown Shard platform.

edicts.name: Monster Tithe
edicts.proclamation: The beasts carry more than their bones.
edicts.description: Winning a monster round grants an extra item component.

edicts.name: War Banners
edicts.proclamation: Hold the line, or break it — either way, the banners fly.
edicts.description: Win and loss streaks of 2 or more pay 1 extra Crown. Interest is unchanged.

edicts.name: The First Armoury
edicts.proclamation: The forges were lit before dawn. Take a blade.
edicts.description: Every contender begins the match with one random item component.

edicts.name: Exalted Dawn
edicts.proclamation: The first light shines brightest on the Crown.
edicts.description: Crown Power offers are rarer, as if they came two stages later. Selection rules are unchanged.

waves.name: Crystal Golem
waves.mechanics: The Golem stuns everything around it.

waves.name: Void Spider Brood
waves.mechanics: The Queen keeps summoning spiderlings: kill her fast.

waves.name: Clockwork Hydra
waves.mechanics: When both heads are destroyed they regrow together: four hatchlings at once.

waves.name: Ancient Treant
waves.mechanics: The Treant regenerates and roots everything within 2 hexes.

waves.name: Celestial Sentinel
waves.mechanics: The Sentinel turns invulnerable for 2.5s and heals 5% at 66% and 33% health.

waves.name: Crown Guardian
waves.mechanics: The Guardian enrages below 50% health: +50% attack speed and damage.

guardianLines.golem: The Crystal Golem. The ground remembers its weight.
guardianLines.spiders: The Void Spider Brood. They never stop coming.
guardianLines.hydra: The Clockwork Hydra. Cut one head, and two return.
guardianLines.treant: The Ancient Treant. The forest heals itself.
guardianLines.sentinel: The Celestial Sentinel. The heavens refuse to fall.
guardianLines.guardian: The Crown Guardian. The Crown defends itself.
